relativeThreshold.rule: lowest z-score threshold with >= 0.8 relevant among returned and no no-match suggestion on v2 development, semantic only
relativeThreshold.note: Added after the first scored holdout run; the cut-off still comes from v2 development only.

semanticVeto.rule: keyword evidence needs a z-score at or above the 5th percentile of correct keyword suggestions on v2 development
